name: org.pitchnetwork/pitch-network
title: The Pitch Network
description: Youth soccer clubs across the western US: search 1,100+ clubs by area, tier, league and gender.

tools.name: pitch-find-clubs
tools.description: Search The Pitch Network youth soccer club directory for the western United States: Southern and Northern California, the Pacific Northwest, the Mountain West and the Southwest. Filter by region, county or city, tier (Elite, Competitive, Recreational), league (for example ECNL, MLS NEXT, Girls Academy), gender, or free-text words. Returns each club's location, tier, leagues, website and verification date. Use pitch/list-areas for valid area names.

query.description: Words to look for in the club name, county, city, region, tier and leagues, such as "Surf" or "Albion". Every word must match. Leave out to list all clubs that fit the other filters.

area.description: Where to look: a region, county or city, county, city or US state name, such as "San Diego", "Boise" or "Colorado". Partial names match. See list-areas for the names this directory uses.

tier.description: Level of play. Elite: national-league clubs such as ECNL, MLS NEXT or Girls Academy. Competitive: travel and club soccer. Recreational: community and AYSO-style programs. A club with teams at more than one level matches each of them.

league.description: A league the club plays in, such as "ECNL", "ECNL RL", "MLS NEXT", "Girls Academy" or "N1L". Partial names match.

gender.description: Only clubs with boys or girls programs. Clubs with both always match.

limit.description: Most results to return, from 1 to 25. Default 10. The response also gives the total number of matches.

tools.name: pitch-list-areas
tools.description: The areas The Pitch Network club directory covers (the western United States: Southern and Northern California, the Pacific Northwest, the Mountain West and the Southwest), with the number of listed clubs in each. Use these names with pitch/find-clubs.

tools.name: pitch-list-sites
tools.description: The regional Pitch Network sites, the areas each covers, and each site's own MCP server URL for guides, tryouts, tournaments and standings recaps in that region.

tools.name: pitch-about
tools.description: What The Pitch Network covers, the other Pitch Network regional sites, and how to cite it.
